plan.title: Donation Overview
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends related to donations.

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total_amount FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT City, SUM(Amount) AS city_total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Donations by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT Mode, SUM(Amount) AS mode_total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Amount) AS monthly_total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS total_donated FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Average Donation Amount
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(Amount) AS avg_amount FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Number of Unique Donors
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS unique_donors FROM donor_transactions

plan.narrative: The dashboard provides a snapshot of donation activity. Total donations reached {{p1}}, with an average donation amount of {{p6}}.
